final_message:
Blog post slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. It decomposes the title (NFKD) and strips the combining accent marks before passing it to `slugify`. The vendored `slugify` was deleting the accented letters outright, so I left it as it is. I didn't touch anything in `vendor/`.

This also changes slugs for any other accented title, not just the test case. The product URL code in `src/shop/product-url.js` uses its own path and is unchanged.
